currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific complete mapped Forbidden City exterior: irregular palace courts and dense east/west gallery compounds; central Supreme/Central/Preserving Harmony halls on triple stone terraces; inner palaces; U-shaped Meridian Gate/five roofed pavilions; north/east/west gates; grey perimeter walls and four cross-roof corner towers. Original central stream/moat/roads remain native, with five specific stone footbridges at mapped crossings. Red walls/columns, gold swept tile roofs/teal beam belts, white stone stairs/balustrades, opaque timber door/lattice panels and grey side roofs use shared surfaces. The panels use the shared wood graph rather than generic glass; their fine lattice pattern is not reproduced. Fine architectural inventory is approximate; furnished halls, collections, inscriptions, copied artwork/banners/crowds and trees are outside this structure model.
